title: George Perez
description: "l felt that the Gamorrean guard would be quite intimidating in extreme close-up," offers George Perez. "Besides, comic art is one of the few places you can make a mask look like the real thing!" A comics pro for 18 vears, Perez has done considerable work for both Marvel and DC, including THE AVENGERS, THE FANTASTIC FOUR, THE NEW TEEN TITANTS, CRISIS ON INFINITE EARTHS, WONDER WOMAN and INFINITY GAUNTLET. Recent accomplishments include HULK: FUTURE IMPERFECT and GLADIATOR for Dark Horse and JURASSIC PARK (inks) for Topps.
